cc:Work.dc:title: Vision: sensitivity and compensation
cc:Work.dc:description: Left: sensitivity normalized to a maximum of 1. Right: reciprocal power, minimum 1, on a logarithmic vertical axis. Vertical guides mark peak sensitivity. The hearing panel is in audio frequency, before the audio-to-light mapping. Vision: CIE (2019), doi:10.25039/CIE.DS.xvudnb9b, CC BY-SA 4.0. Hearing: ISO 226:2023, Equation (1) and Table 1, 60 phon. Hearing sensitivity is an inverse-required-power proxy, not a linear loudness response.
